name: WANNABE→CREATORS 2
source:
The protagonist, Akitsu Ren, was living a happy creative life...or so he thought.

He met heroines who were devoting their lives to creation, deepened their bonds, and was doing well as the master of his harem.

However, one day, he suddenly overheard a secret conversation about being expelled from the harem.

"I think we should distance ourselves from him..."

"(I'm going to be expelled...!? Me...!?)"

There were too many instances where it felt right.
This is because, even though Ren aspires to be a creator, he had yet to complete an "original work."

In despair, Ren leaves Ria's mansion alone.
A beautiful girl picked him up as he wandered the park with nowhere to go.

"There's someone I need to catch up with. So please teach me the scenario."

Ren's creative talent was discovered by a beautiful artist named Shia.

The place where he was brought by chance was...
an isolated island in the middle of the ocean in the Reiwa era, an abandoned industry.
--A certain eroge company on the verge of collapse.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ01004241.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公秋津莲过着幸福的创作生活……至少他是这么认为的。

他结识了毕生致力于创作的女主角，加深了彼此的羁绊，并在后宫做得很好。

然而有一天，他突然听到一段关于被逐出后宫的秘密谈话。

“我觉得我们应该和他保持距离……”

“（我要被开除了……！？我……！？）”

有太多的例子感觉这是正确的。
这是因为，尽管任志强立志成为一名创作者，但他还没有完成一部“原创作品”。

雷恩绝望地独自离开了莉亚的宅邸。
当他在公园里徘徊无处可去时，一个美丽的女孩把他抱了起来。

“我需要联系一个人。所以请教我这个场景。”

任的创作天赋被一位名叫希亚的美丽艺术家发现。

偶然带他去的地方是……
令和时代，一座位于大洋中央的孤岛，废弃的工业。
——某游戏公司濒临倒闭。
